description: This Java class defines the LoanProduct entity in the Fineract project, representing loan product configurations including constraints, rates, charges, and related details. It includes validation, update methods, and fetchers for various loan parameters.

classes.name: LoanProduct
classes.description: Entity representing a loan product configuration, including constraints, rates, charges, and related details, with validation and update methods.

methods.name: updateLoanProductInRelatedClasses
methods.description: Updates related classes with current product state, especially interest recalculation and guarantee details.

methods.name: validateLoanProductPreSave
methods.description: Performs validation checks before saving the loan product, ensuring consistency of rules and constraints.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency associated with the loan product.

methods.name: hasCurrencyCodeOf
methods.description: Checks if the loan product's currency matches the provided currency code.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the charges associated with the loan product if there are changes.

methods.name: updateRates
methods.description: Updates the rates associated with the loan product if there are changes.

methods.name: loanProductFloatingRates
methods.description: Returns the floating rates configuration, initializing if null.

methods.name: loanProductVariableInstallmentConfig
methods.description: Returns the variable installment configuration, initializing if null.

methods.name: isAccountingDisabled
methods.description: Checks if accounting is disabled for this product.

methods.name: isCashBasedAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if cash-based accounting is enabled.

methods.name: isUpfrontAccrualAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if upfront accrual accounting is enabled.

methods.name: isPeriodicAccrualAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if periodic accrual accounting is enabled.

methods.name: getPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Returns the principal amount as Money object.

methods.name: getMinPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Returns the minimum principal amount as Money object.

methods.name: getMaxPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Returns the maximum principal amount as Money object.

methods.name: getNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the nominal interest rate per period.

methods.name: getInterestPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the interest period frequency type.

methods.name: getMinNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the minimum nominal interest rate per period.

methods.name: getMaxNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the maximum nominal interest rate per period.

methods.name: getNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Returns the number of repayments.

methods.name: getMinNumberOfReapayments
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of repayments.

methods.name: getMaxNumberOfReapayments
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of repayments.

methods.name: loanProductMinMaxConstraints
methods.description: Returns or initializes the min/max constraints for the product.

methods.name: isMultiDisburseLoan
methods.description: Checks if the loan is multi-disbursal.

methods.name: outstandingLoanBalance
methods.description: Returns the outstanding loan balance.

methods.name: maxTrancheCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum tranche count.

methods.name: isInterestRecalculationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if interest recalculation is enabled.

methods.name: preCloseInterestCalculationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the pre-close interest calculation strategy.

methods.name: fetchInterestRates
methods.description: Fetches applicable interest rates based on floating rate configuration.

methods.name: isEqualAmortization
methods.description: Checks if the product uses equal amortization.

methods.name: getRepaymentStartDateType
methods.description: Returns the repayment start date type.

methods.name: updateEnableInstallmentLevelDelinquency
methods.description: Enables or disables installment level delinquency.
